source.label: Bundled calculator assumptions
source.methodology: Configurable planning policy informed by risk-based governance, data minimization and processing-boundary control. These labels are not an industry-wide legal classification and should be edited for the user's organization, region and operating environment.

description.en: Routine language tasks with clear instructions and limited reasoning depth; efficiency matters more than handling difficult edge cases.
description.zh-CN: 适合指令清晰、推理深度有限的常规语言任务；更看重资源效率，不要求处理复杂边界情况。

example.en: Examples: classification, extraction, short summaries and FAQ drafting.
example.zh-CN: 示例：分类、信息抽取、短摘要和常见问答草拟。

recommendationImpact.en: The calculator may choose the smallest eligible model with supporting evidence.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 计算器可选择有证据支持的最小可用模型。

description.en: General business quality for common knowledge work, with moderate reasoning and instruction following at a practical cost.
description.zh-CN: 面向常见知识工作的通用业务质量，在适中成本下提供中等推理与指令遵循能力。

example.en: Examples: internal copilots, document Q&A, routine analysis and everyday coding assistance.
example.zh-CN: 示例：内部 Copilot、文档问答、常规分析和日常编程辅助。

recommendationImpact.en: The calculator favors mainstream mid-tier models that balance quality, speed and cost.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 计算器会偏向在质量、速度与成本之间折中的主流中档模型。

description.en: Complex multi-step work that needs stronger reasoning, coding, tool use or long-context reliability, where errors have meaningful business impact.
description.zh-CN: 适合需要更强推理、编程、工具调用或长上下文可靠性的复杂多步任务，错误会带来明显业务影响。

example.en: Examples: coding agents, complex RAG synthesis, workflow agents and expert document review.
example.zh-CN: 示例：编程 Agent、复杂 RAG 综合、工作流 Agent 和专家级文档审阅。

recommendationImpact.en: The calculator requires a higher-ranked model and may accept higher memory, latency or cost.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 计算器会要求更高能力档模型，并可能接受更高显存、延迟或成本。

description.en: The hardest novel, expert or high-consequence tasks where the best available capability is prioritized over cost and deployment simplicity.
description.zh-CN: 面向最困难、创新性强、专家级或高后果任务，优先追求当前最佳能力，而非成本和部署简易度。

example.en: Examples: difficult research, frontier agentic coding and high-stakes expert analysis with human review.
example.zh-CN: 示例：高难度研究、前沿 Agent 编程，以及配有人审的高风险专家分析。

recommendationImpact.en: The calculator considers only the highest configured capability tier; cloud escalation may be required if local evidence is insufficient.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 计算器只考虑配置中最高能力档；本地证据不足时可能需要升级到云端。

description.en: Public, synthetic or non-sensitive content. External cloud processing is normally acceptable.
description.zh-CN: 公开、合成或非敏感内容，通常可以接受外部云端处理。

example.en: Examples: public documents, demos and synthetic test data.
example.zh-CN: 示例：公开文档、演示内容和合成测试数据。

recommendationImpact.en: Cloud is allowed; capability and economics drive the recommendation.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 允许使用云端，推荐主要由能力与经济性决定。

description.en: Routine internal business data without regulated or high-value secrets. Use approved providers and retention controls.
description.zh-CN: 常规内部业务数据，不包含受监管信息或高价值机密；应使用获批服务商并控制数据留存。

example.en: Examples: internal summaries, ordinary operations and non-sensitive support content.
example.zh-CN: 示例：内部摘要、常规运营资料和非敏感客服内容。

recommendationImpact.en: Cloud remains possible when organizational controls are satisfied.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 满足组织安全控制后仍可采用云端。

description.en: Raw sensitive content stays inside an organization-controlled local or private boundary. Hybrid processing may send only redacted, minimized context or a non-sensitive subtask to an approved cloud.
description.zh-CN: 原始敏感内容留在组织可控的本地或私有边界内；混合计算只能向获批云端发送脱敏、最小化后的上下文或非敏感子任务。

example.en: Examples: unreleased products, private repositories and customer-confidential documents.
example.zh-CN: 示例：未发布产品、私有代码库和客户保密文档。

recommendationImpact.en: Local or Hybrid is preferred. Public cloud must not receive raw sensitive fields; any escalation requires explicit organizational controls.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 优先本地或混合部署；公共云不得接收原始敏感字段，任何云端升级都必须经过明确的组织控制。

description.en: All prompts, context, retrieved data, outputs and inference telemetry remain inside the approved local, on-premises or sovereign boundary.
description.zh-CN: 提示词、上下文、检索数据、输出和推理遥测全部留在获批的本地、企业内网或主权边界内。

example.en: Examples: protected health data, classified workloads and strict data-residency cases.
example.zh-CN: 示例：受保护健康数据、涉密工作负载和严格数据驻留场景。

recommendationImpact.en: Public-cloud inference is prohibited by this planning policy. Local is a hard requirement; the calculator reports a conflict when no capable local path exists.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 本规划策略禁止公共云推理；本地部署是硬性要求，没有可行本地方案时计算器会明确报告约束冲突。

description.en: Background or asynchronous work where the user is not waiting on every response.
description.zh-CN: 后台或异步任务，用户不会等待每一次响应。

example.en: Examples: batch classification, nightly summaries and offline document processing.
example.zh-CN: 示例：批量分类、夜间摘要和离线文档处理。

recommendationImpact.en: Planning target: first token within about 10 seconds; throughput and cost usually matter more.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 规划目标：首 Token 约 10 秒内；通常吞吐量和成本更重要。

description.en: A person is actively waiting, but a short conversational pause is acceptable.
description.zh-CN: 用户正在等待响应，但可以接受短暂的对话停顿。

example.en: Examples: chat assistants, document Q&A and internal copilots.
example.zh-CN: 示例：聊天助手、文档问答和内部 Copilot。

recommendationImpact.en: Planning target: first token within about 2 seconds.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 规划目标：首 Token 约 2 秒内。

description.en: The response should feel immediate enough to preserve a rapid working rhythm.
description.zh-CN: 响应应足够即时，以保持快速连续的工作节奏。

example.en: Examples: coding assistance, rapid search and high-frequency agent interaction.
example.zh-CN: 示例：编程辅助、快速检索和高频 Agent 交互。

recommendationImpact.en: Planning target: first token within about 1 second.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 规划目标：首 Token 约 1 秒内。

description.en: Delay interrupts a live conversation or control loop and must be minimized end to end.
description.zh-CN: 延迟会打断实时对话或控制循环，需要尽量降低端到端等待。

example.en: Examples: live voice turns, operator assistance and interactive control.
example.zh-CN: 示例：实时语音轮次、操作员辅助和交互控制。

recommendationImpact.en: Planning target: first token within about 0.25 seconds; the engine prefers a local network path when feasible.
recommendationImpact.zh-CN: 规划目标：首 Token 约 0.25 秒内；可行时引擎会偏好本地网络路径。
